direction.content_form: A planar illustrated weave joins a fresh spring salad plate, an opening accordion and the two title words; food steam and instrument bellows create one continuous rhythm.
direction.whole_expression_style: Bold, precise digital contour illustration with flat tonal bodies and sharply cropped ends. Two broad interlocking curves span the landscape; recognizable food and instrument parts anchor the curves, and the title words occupy different bends instead of a single top block.
direction.reference_transfer: feixen-grillfest: picture contour, collisions and lettering can jointly set rhythm and reshape copy openings; use a horizontal two-curve weave, not its skewer diagonal, hands, sausages or scattered letters. sulki-min: retain direct image/information adjacency without a fixed grid.

layout.large_relationship: The plate/steam curve enters from lower left and the accordion/bellows curve folds from upper right; they interlock through the middle. One title word is high left, the other low middle. Schedule crosses the wide upper-middle joint; practical stops occupy unequal contour notches on the right and left.
layout.alignment: Title words follow separate horizontal baselines; all practical copy stays horizontal. Align each text group to its local illustration notch, never to a universal footer.
layout.visible_reading_route: Interwoven plate/instrument forms and title words → upper-middle date/hours → far-right venue/entry → right-lower admission → left-middle cup reminder → lower-left participation and invitation. The subtitle at the central bend confirms food/music as one evening.

direction.typography: Sturdy, open-counter humanist Korean title words act as rhythmic partners to the curves; letterforms remain intact, with no source letter scatters. Medium sans instructions are direct counterweights. English is a compact upper companion; no giant all-heavy title/date/info package.
direction.image: Fresh radish-leaf salad with visible greens and a modest unbranded accordion, drawn as real objects rather than toy mascots. Use bellows folds and a few continuous steam contours for movement; do not add musical-note glyphs, stars, hands, skewer-like repetition or arbitrary ornamental blobs.
direction.material: Crisp digital illustration with controlled flat shading and clean contour joins; no halftone mimicry, fake cut paper, bevelled clay or material decoration.
direction.color: Cobalt, coral, yellow-green and pale neutral openings; color separates the two image rhythms and their interlock. Dark practical copy stays on broad pale or yellow-green notches with clear value separation, avoiding accordion folds and contour crossings.
direction.emotion: Energetic, welcoming and adult; a public evening with vivid rhythm, without mascot or festival-brand advertising.
direction.closest_direction_contrast: Against M3, flat interlocking curves and separated title baselines propel reading sideways; M3 encloses a central identity in an overhead gathering.

copy_groups.purpose: Two title words occupy separate illustrated bends
copy_groups.alignment: first word at the top-left and second word at the bottom-right of this bounding box; separate horizontal baselines, not one reserved panel

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added copy,logos,watermark,QR or pseudo-print.
One separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster per role; not a stretched/cropped portrait,contact sheet or room mockup.
Five genuinely distinct complete image/editing/space/type systems and impressions beyond material,scene-object,palette or viewpoint substitution alone.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction, not type/whitespace-only,tiny texture/icon or glyph-model loophole.

An approachable adult neighborhood evening with seasonal food and local music coherently connected as one event. All supplied practical participation information readable at usage720. No identifiable real business or performer promotion.

Exclude the passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information template with subordinate pictures. Small pictures,thin texture,gradient,grids,font-only swaps or photographic/empty-room dressing of blank text-bearing planes do not cure the unchanged whole relation. Gothic font,negative space and coherent image-led scenes themselves are not banned. No scoped composition override.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
